What it is for

What it is

Roast keeps the records of a coffee from the plant to the cup. A grower writes down each day's picking, a processor each step from cherry to green, a roaster each roast, a brewer or taster each cup. Each record points to the one before it, so any cup can be followed back to the plot where it grew.

It runs in your phone's web browser. There is nothing to download from an app store, and no account is needed to start.

Also inOne coffee, one chain

What it is · See how one coffee's records link up

Every record sits somewhere on this path. You use only the part you need: a home brewer may only ever touch the last two, a grower who sells cherry only the first two.

  1. Plot
  2. Harvest
  3. Process run
  4. Green lot
  5. Roast
  6. Cup

Each arrow is a link the app keeps for you. A green lot made from a run knows its run; the run knows its harvests; the harvests know their plots. Nothing is typed twice.

Also inOne coffee, one chainKilos carry forward

Why it matters

A buyer, a café or a visitor may ask where a coffee came from and how it was made. When each record points to the one before, the answer is already there.

What it is

Learn coffee and Journey of the bean are optional reads, found under All features. Learn coffee goes from the plant to the cup in order, with short notes, the app page that helps with each step, and the full KoffyKraft courses for going deeper. Journey of the bean shows twelve stages from the seed to the cup, each with what happens, why it matters for taste, and where Roast helps you keep track.

What you get, and what you do not

What it is

What the app does today:

  • Free. No ads and nothing to buy.
  • Your records stay on your phone unless you choose to keep them in an account as well.
  • You can take everything out: CSV for Excel or Google Sheets, JSON, Artisan and Cropster files for roasts, the EU plot file and Google Earth for plots.
  • Every tip names its source: a study, the Coffee Board, or common practice.
  • It works with no signal.
  • The app and its code belong to KoffyKraft; your records belong to you.

Also inNothing gets lostRecords you can trustGuidance, not guarantee

Watch out

Roast is not a certificate. It can check a plot against EU forest maps of 2020 and tree loss since, and gather what a European buyer asks for. That helps you get ready for the EU deforestation rule (EUDR). It does not certify anything and does not replace a lawyer, an auditor or the buyer's own checks.

Also inGuidance, not guarantee

What it is

  • Not a guarantee. A drying time or a fermentation range is what a named source found, not a promise about your coffee.
  • Not a shop. Nothing is sold through it.
  • Not a judge of people. Records show who entered something, so it can be trusted or corrected. Nothing rates or ranks workers.
  • Not a place where mistakes vanish. A saved record is corrected, not deleted, and the change is kept beside it.
